mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.instance_id, t.node_name, t.node_type, t.assignee_id, t.status, t.comment, t.handle_time, t.create_time, pd.name AS process_name, wi.title AS instance_title, wi.initiator_id, wi.start_time FROM wf_task t LEFT JOIN wf_instance wi ON t.instance_id = wi.id LEFT JOIN wf_process_def pd ON wi.process_def_id = pd.id WHERE t.assignee_id = #{assigneeId} AND t.status = 0 AND t.deleted = 0 ORDER BY t.create_time DESC

SELECT t.id, t.instance_id, t.node_name, t.node_type, t.assignee_id, t.status, t.comment, t.handle_time, t.create_time, pd.name AS process_name, wi.title AS instance_title, wi.initiator_id, wi.start_time FROM wf_task t LEFT JOIN wf_instance wi ON t.instance_id = wi.id LEFT JOIN wf_process_def pd ON wi.process_def_id = pd.id WHERE t.assignee_id = #{assigneeId} AND t.status != 0 AND t.deleted = 0 ORDER BY t.handle_time DESC
